login.title: Sign in
login.heroBody: Japanese document OCR — from the scan bed to a structured result.

masters.title: Master data
masters.matchableHint: Matchable fields are compared against OCR output automatically; hits are highlighted.
masters.aliasHint: When a misread name is linked to this record, the exact scanned text is remembered so future scans link automatically.
masters.importWhichType: What kind of data are you importing?
masters.importWhichTypeHint: Pick the master type these rows belong to — e.g. customers or products. The file's header row must use this type's field names.
masters.importChooseFile: Choose a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file
masters.importFileHint: The first row must be a header. Both field keys and field labels are accepted; UTF-8 and Shift-JIS CSVs work.
masters.importHasHeader: First row is a header (not data)
masters.noFieldsHint: No columns defined yet — just create the type with a name, then bulk import: the file's header row becomes the columns.
masters.linked: Linked — corrected with the master value
masters.rematchHint: Run matching again after updating masters

scan.title: Scan
scan.subtitle: Uploaded documents are OCR-processed automatically. Scanner auto-import is handled by DocuEngine Watcher.
scan.dropHere: Drop files here, or click to select
scan.templateHint: Fields will be extracted automatically from every file uploaded below

templates.title: Template management
templates.name: Template name
templates.fieldDescription: Synonyms / context (e.g. 伝票番号, No.)
templates.fieldHint: The label is searched on the document; the value next to or below it is captured. Add comma-separated synonyms in the context column for labels that vary.
templates.confirmDelete: Delete template "{{name}}"? Documents keep their extracted values.
templates.empty: No templates yet — create one to extract structured fields from scans.
templates.fieldsHint: Click a value to correct it (saves on Enter or focus-out). Hover a row to highlight where it was found on the scan.

documents.title: Documents
documents.reclassifyHint: Detect the category of already-scanned documents from their text

detail.visibilityHint: Toggle who can see this document

editor.title: Correct OCR result
editor.submitted: Correction submitted. It will be used as training data.

devices.title: Scanner devices
devices.name: Device name
devices.tokenNote: This token is shown only once. Configure it in the watcher app.

companies.title: Companies
companies.name: Company name
companies.slugHint: Identifier: lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens. Filled in from the name — you can edit it.
companies.slugTaken: That identifier is already in use. Pick a different slug.
companies.adminEmailHint: Use a different email than the Sonasu super-admin login.
companies.emailTaken: That email is already registered. Use a different address.
companies.passwordNotStored: Password is not stored in this list. Share it now if you still have it.
companies.confirmDelete: Delete {{email}}? They will no longer be able to sign in.
companies.confirmDeleteCompany: Delete company "{{name}}" and all of its documents and users?
